description.value: Rust Wine Co is a boutique estate winery on the Golden Mile Bench in Oliver, BC, drawing grapes from five vineyards — some planted as far back as 1963 — to produce small-lot, single-vineyard wines that reflect distinct Okanagan and Similkameen terroirs. The property includes a tasting room with sweeping views over Black Sage Bench toward Osoyoos, and a restored 19th-century heritage bunkhouse available as vacation accommodation. Regular live music events make it a social stop on a corridor that is one of BC's most popular cycling routes.
